## Server

### Fixed
- The server starts its world again on the September 15 Delverium demo update. That update changed how a new character's defaults are built, and the server never got past creating its own character, so every world sat unstarted and the gameplay port stayed closed.
- The live map draws again on that update. Item and ground-tile descriptions moved, and the map scanner was reading fields that no longer exist.

## Client

### Fixed
- Creating a character for a new server on the September 15 demo update works again; the connect files the app installs carry the same fix as the server.
